about: Upper limits of the bundles' sizes (tools/ci_checks.py sizes, CI). Set about 10 % above the sizes after the vias-in-3D merge and the channel export with its LTspice bench and export settings (2026-10-25: kisi.html 3.20 MB, kisi-examples.html 6.83 MB, kisi.mjs 2.54 MB; before them 2.87 / 6.50 / 2.22 MB); with accuracy and the Prepare PCB page 3.43 / 7.20 / 2.64 MB, still within. With the fab stackups, the stackup comparison and the tolerance band (feat/stackup-variants; the engine 5.62 → 5.91 MB raw) kisi.html 3.52 → 3.65 MB (3,650,540 bytes): its limit raised to 3.70 MB; kisi-examples.html 7.33 MB and kisi.mjs 2.79 MB stay within theirs. A change that makes a bundle larger on purpose raises the limit in the same commit.
